descriptions.zh-Hans: 在河内吃过牛肉河粉的菜单，开头像一封暖乎乎的信。
descriptions.en: My Hanoi beef pho menu, opening rather like a warm little letter.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在河内尝过烤肉米线的记录，菜名上方留着“今天歇在这里”。
descriptions.en: A menu after bun cha in Hanoi, with “Resting here today” above the dish name.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在河内还剑湖边等旅伴的便签，空着的地方留给会合地点的小名。
descriptions.en: A note from waiting by Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi, with space for our meeting spot’s nickname.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在河内吃牛肉河粉时想到的信开头，后半句还在慢慢来。
descriptions.en: A letter opening that arrived over beef pho in Hanoi. The rest is taking its time.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 参观河内文庙后用自己的纸记下的三个短句，留着慢慢看的节奏。
descriptions.en: Three phrases on my own paper after visiting Hanoi’s Temple of Literature, keeping the pace of an unhurried look.

names.en: No Hurry for the Early One

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我和旅伴给还剑湖边的会合地点起的小名，只在我们自己的便签上使用。
descriptions.en: A private nickname a companion and I gave our Hoan Kiem Lake meeting spot, saved on our own note.
